qualification: PROVISIONAL N05 diagnostic entry budget; unarmed simulation only, not a flight clearance

geometry.rotor_sweep_method: Sweep each x500 propeller collision rectangle through its complete revolute-Z range; union is a disk at the measured rotor center and collision half-thickness.
geometry.ground_contact_geometry: The two 0.25 x 0.015 x 0.015 m skid crossbars at y=+/-0.132 m and z=-0.2195 m in base_link; no other x500 or camera collision may contact ground.

spatial_budget.combination: linear sum; measured N01 10 s RPE maximum + N04 cross-layout maximum surface residual + half a 0.1 m voxel diagonal + 0.025 m sweep sampling allowance
limitations: N01 RPE maximum and N04 residual maximum are observed finite-sample values under low-speed unarmed support motion, not hard bounds.
The additive sum is intentionally conservative and may double-count localization effects already present in N04 map residuals.
Mount bracket, cable, connectors, manufacturing tolerance, control tracking, latency, braking distance, vibration, and tilted-flight geometry are not measured or included.
A pass is only an observation/map-entry diagnostic for a stationary or vertically swept low-speed unarmed pose; it does not authorize flight.

map_policy.classification: raw occupancy only; inflation mask is diagnostic and never converts unknown to free
map_policy.self_filter: No vehicle-shaped voxels are erased and no free rays are synthesized. Near-camera and image-margin filtering follows the existing plan_env depth filter; self-occluded volume remains unknown and is rejected if it intersects the required entry envelope.

ground_contact.plane_source: robust horizontal plane fitted only from current raw occupied voxels in the local landing pad; debug_truth and complete world geometry are forbidden inputs
ground_contact.ground_plane_voxel_boundary_rule: A raw occupied voxel is eligible when its cell intersects the plane-search height interval; compare its center through the interval limit plus half one map resolution.
ground_contact.allowed_ground_surface_region: raw occupied voxels within 0.05 m of the fitted plane and inside the current nominal aircraft XY footprint, only during a landed takeoff contact, its vertical ascent, a planned descent, or confirmed landing contact
ground_contact.contact_verification: PX4 landed state plus a valid raw-map plane; fixture attachment is diagnostic evidence only and cannot assert an unsupported airborne state.
ground_contact.all_other_geometry: must be raw known free throughout the uncertainty-expanded sweep
ground_contact.unknown_at_contact_patch: reject; physical support does not silently clear unknown voxels

entry_phases.TAKEOFF_CONTACT: Verify current landed pose and skid-only ground contact; all other uncertainty-expanded geometry must be known free.
entry_phases.ASCENT: Sample the complete vertical swept envelope from the contact pose to the hold height; allow only the observed floor plane below the skid footprint until nominal skid clearance exceeds the uncertainty margin, then require every intersecting voxel known free.
entry_phases.HOLD: Require the complete orientation-invariant envelope and a 0.25 m hold neighborhood known free; map identity and source freshness are checked continuously.
entry_phases.DESCENT: Check the complete reverse vertical sweep against the same fresh map; only the observed ground plane may intersect the skid footprint in the final contact band.
entry_phases.LANDING_CONTACT: Require PX4 landed confirmation, the same verified plane, and skid-only contact; all other geometry must remain known free.

conditions: same live VINS epoch, map_id, frame, calibration and input-config hashes from scan through admission
fresh raw-map snapshot acquired after the support scan reaches the takeoff pose
vehicle remains DISARMED and no navigation goal or control command is published
support release produces no pose discontinuity above the configured spatial budget and no map reset
online admission re-runs after support release; a pre-scan result alone never authorizes takeoff
prescan_transfer.current_fixture_limit: The existing gantry is attached to base_link and is not a flight-qualified ground rest; its pass cannot prove physical transfer to unsupported takeoff.
